label: an approximate reconstruction from the cited claims, not the experiment's geometry
subsystem: Transition Radiation Detector: 20 layers of fleece radiator and straw tubes

quantities.name: straw_layers
quantities.definition: number of straw-tube layers (volumes tagged straw_layer) in the expanded IR
quantities.derivation: 20 layers (ams02:C67, S01 Section 1.3: 328 modules on 20 layers, 4 + 12 + 4)

independence.result: a design count from the tier-1 review, not a simulation output; the case is built from the same count, so it checks how the layers are expressed (one top layer and a linear placement of 19), not physics

negative_control.change: the linear placement holds 18 layers instead of 19 (one layer lost)

quantities.name: layer_radiator_x0
quantities.definition: x/X0 of the fleece radiator of one layer (the top layer, tag radiator_top) at normal incidence
quantities.derivation: 2.0 cm (ams02:C67, S01 tier 1; the 22 mm of ams02:C212, tier 3, is not used) x 0.06 g/cm3 (ams02:C67) / 44.77 g/cm2 (PDG polyethylene, ams02:C208; polypropylene has the same (CH2)n composition) = 0.0026804. The straw gas is not part of the quantity (its density at the flight pressure and temperature is not in the sources read).

sources.source: PDG Atomic and Nuclear Properties, polyethylene (2024 web edition; ledger ams02:S74)
sources.value: radiation length 44.77 g/cm2; mass fractions H 0.143711, C 0.856289

independence.result: independent of Geant4: thickness and density from the tier-1 review (S01), radiation length PDG's tabulation for (CH2)n. The reference is not a Geant4 output. Geant4 computes radiation lengths with the same Tsai formula PDG tabulates, so agreement validates the geometry and the material definition (composition and density), not Geant4's radiation-length physics.

negative_control.change: the 22 mm radiator of the tier-3 proceedings (ams02:C212) instead of S01's 20 mm

quantities.tolerance_basis: fixed before any measurement: the reference uses the specification's own thickness and density, so the residual is Geant4's radiation length of (CH2)n against PDG's (expected within 1%) and the geantino path (exact); 3%, as the S6 TOF case, keeps the 10% control outside

approximations: the fleece radiator is a homogeneous slab of polyethylene at 0.06 g/cm3; its fibre structure (10 micrometre fibres, ams02:C212) matters for transition radiation, not for the radiation length
fleece thickness 20 mm (S01, tier 1); the 22 mm of the 2013 proceedings (tier 3) is the negative control

each straw layer is a 6 mm slab of G4_Xe (NIST xenon gas) across the whole 2 m width: the straw walls (72 micrometre kapton-aluminium, research only), wires and the 10% CO2 are not modelled; no case quantity crosses the gas
the tapered octagon (80 cm high, 200 cm and 150 cm wide, ams02:C212) is a 2 m square prism of the maximum tube length; layer orientations (4 x, 12 y, 4 x) and the support structure are not modelled
the TRD sits at the origin; its flight position (z = 80-155 cm, from flight-data vertices) is not modelled
status: comparison with cited values: not validated
